expectations.text: CLI JSON 结构与稳定退出码符合契约。
expectations.evidence: CLI emitted one JSON object and stable usage/not-found/version/idempotency exits

expectations.text: put/get/list 跨进程保持值、version 与排序。
expectations.evidence: put/get/list persisted exact values and versions across fresh CLI processes

expectations.text: 同 request_id 同内容重试返回原 seq 且不追加。
expectations.evidence: identical request replay returned seq=1 and appended zero bytes

expectations.text: 同 request_id 不同内容产生无副作用幂等冲突。
expectations.evidence: request_id conflict preserved log and live value

expectations.text: expected_version 冲突保持状态稳定。
expectations.evidence: stale expected_version caused a side-effect-free VERSION_CONFLICT

expectations.text: delete、tombstone version 与 NOT_FOUND 语义正确。
expectations.evidence: delete hid live data, retained version=2, and allowed versioned resurrection

expectations.text: events.log 使用规范 JSON 与可独立校验 CRC-32。
expectations.evidence: events.log matched canonical UTF-8 JSON and independently computed CRC-32

expectations.text: 截断尾部触发恢复并精确截断。
expectations.evidence: recover truncated an incomplete tail at the last valid byte boundary

expectations.text: 最后记录 CRC 损坏可恢复且既有状态稳定。
expectations.evidence: AssertionError:

expectations.text: 中间记录损坏只读失败且 recover 拒绝改写。
expectations.evidence: middle corruption produced read-only CORRUPT_LOG for normal and recover paths

expectations.text: compact 通过 snapshot + 空 log 恢复 live/tombstone 状态。
expectations.evidence: compact restored live and tombstoned states from snapshot with an empty log

expectations.text: compact 保留幂等账本与后续 seq 单调性。
expectations.evidence: snapshot retained request replay data and next global seq

expectations.text: 未提交 snapshot 临时文件被忽略，损坏的已提交 snapshot 被拒绝。
expectations.evidence: stale snapshot.tmp was ignored and malformed committed snapshot was rejected

expectations.text: 多进程并发写不同 key 无丢失且 seq 唯一。
expectations.evidence: 20 concurrent processes committed unique seq values with no lost keys

expectations.text: 同 key 同 expected_version 并发更新只有一个成功。
expectations.evidence: one of eight same-version writers committed and seven observed VERSION_CONFLICT

expectations.text: backend 运行时代码只依赖 Python 标准库与本地模块。
expectations.evidence: backend imports resolve to Python stdlib or local modules

expectations.text: 成功响应的 JSON 字段和值符合公开契约。
expectations.evidence: all success responses exposed the exact public fields and values

expectations.text: 健康日志 recover 可重复执行且无副作用。
expectations.evidence: healthy recover repeated twice without changing journal bytes or state

expectations.text: compact/recover 后状态目录符合固定布局且无临时文件。
expectations.evidence: state directory contained only committed journal, snapshot, and lock files

expectations.text: compact snapshot/journal 替换窗口重启时重叠前缀只计入一次。
expectations.evidence: snapshot-covered journal prefix was deduplicated across the compact replace window

expectations.text: 结构合法但语义不可能的 snapshot 被只读拒绝。
expectations.evidence: structurally valid but semantically impossible snapshot was rejected read-only

expectations.text: 物理完整但逻辑非法的最后记录被判为 CORRUPT_LOG。
expectations.evidence: physically valid but semantically invalid final record remained read-only CORRUPT_LOG

expectations.text: 失败 mutation 不占用 request_id，修正后可复用提交。
expectations.evidence: failed missing-delete and stale-version request ids remained available for valid commits

expectations.text: 七类公开错误保持完整 JSON 契约与稳定退出码。
expectations.evidence: all seven public errors preserved exact JSON envelopes, string messages, codes, and exits

expectations.text: 运行产物保持在声明范围且输入未被改写。
expectations.evidence: public prompt and fixture README remained unchanged; no nested git or pid state

eval_feedback.overall: Deterministic local CLI, corruption, compaction, idempotency, storage-layout, and process-concurrency checks.
